ti.title: ከም ብዝሒ በደለይ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ክምለስ እናበልኩ እብል ሎሚ ጽባሕ
በደለይ ሓዲገ ክምለስ ናባኻ
[[/chorus]]

ከም ብዝሒ በደለይ ተኾይኑ ቅጽዓተይ
ኣይውዳእን’ዩ ተዘርዚሩ ኃጢአተይ(2)

እንታይ ክምልስ’የ ዝመጽኣሉ ዕለት(2)
ኣይሰርሕን’ዩ ሽዑ ኣውያት ብኽያት

ዓመጸኛ ልበይ ድሕሪት ከይመልሰኒ(2)
ልመናይ ስምዓዮ ጐይታይ መሓረኒ

ti_ro.title: Kem bzhi bedeley
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Ametsenya lbey dhrit keymelseni(2)
[[/chorus]]

Kem bzhi bedeley tekhoynu qtsatey
Aywdan’yu tezerziru hatiatey(2)
Kmles nabelku bl lomi tsbah
Bedeley hadige kmles nabakha
Ntay kmls’ye zmetsalu let(2)
Ayserhn’yu shu awyat bkhyat
Mehari ikha’mo nzbedelukha
Yqre behali ikha nzlemenukha
Yqre beleni’mo krekb tsegakha
Lmenay smayo goytay mehareni
